boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UCLA Library study environments, from quiet reading rooms to reservable collaboration spaces.

cards.title: Powell First Floor Study Hall
cards.subtitle: Powell Library
cards.notes: Set up in this large, quiet reading room when you need a focused session; current UCLA students, faculty, and staff may use it overnight during Night Powell.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Powell reading room that also serves as the Night Powell overnight study location.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library describes the Powell First Floor Study Hall as a large, quiet reading room and an overnight study space for UCLA students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Night Powell access is reserved for current UCLA students, faculty, and staff; check the library’s current hours and Night Powell dates before going.

cards.title: Powell Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Powell Library
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work to this quiet second-floor room and use the nearby Powell Community Collections when a study break calls for browsing.
cards.short_summary: A quiet historic-library study room with access to the Powell Community Collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library identifies the Powell Main Reading Room as a quiet study space on Powell Library’s second floor with access to the Powell Community Collections.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor; consult Powell Library’s current location page for building hours.

cards.title: Rose Gilbert Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Powell Library
cards.notes: Choose a chair or couch past the Rotunda for magazine, journal, or laptop reading; keep the room’s stated quiet atmosphere in mind.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Powell room with comfortable seating and popular magazines and journals.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library says the Rose Gilbert Reading Room is a quiet second-floor space past the Rotunda with popular magazines, journals, chairs, and couches.
cards.access_notes: Find it on Powell’s second floor, past the Rotunda; check current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Powell Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: First floor, Powell Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a project meeting of up to eight and plan to use its table, power outlets, and screen for shared work.
cards.short_summary: Six reservable first-floor Powell rooms designed for small-group collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library states that Powell has six group study rooms by the first-floor reading room, with seating, power outlets, and a screen for up to eight people.
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; current UCLA undergraduate and graduate students, faculty, and staff may reserve eligible study spaces subject to UCLA Library policy.

cards.title: CLICC Loop Booths
cards.subtitle: Powell Library
cards.notes: Use a sound-resistant individual booth when you need a small desk and outlets for concentrated solo work; confirm availability on arrival.
cards.short_summary: Individual sound-resistant booths with desks and power in Powell Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library describes CLICC Loop Booths in Powell Library as individual sound-resistant spaces equipped with a small desk and outlets.
cards.source_title: Reserving a Study Space | UCLA Library
cards.access_notes: Individual spaces are listed by UCLA Library; confirm current availability and Powell Library hours before visiting.

cards.title: YRL Reading Room
cards.subtitle: 11720 Charles E. Young Research Library
cards.notes: Work near power outlets and the reference collection, then use the room’s scanner or lockers as needed for a longer research-focused session.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor YRL study room with power, scanning, lockers, and reference materials.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library says the first-floor YRL Reading Room at 11720 YRL has study space with power outlets, a scanner, lockers, and the reference collection.
cards.source_title: Charles E. Young Research Library | UCLA Library
cards.access_notes: Located in room 11720 on YRL’s first floor; check the Research Library location page for current hours.

cards.title: YRL Collaboration Pods
cards.subtitle: First-floor YRL Research Commons
cards.notes: Reserve a pod for a six-to-eight-person working session and connect a laptop to the LCD screen for a shared review or presentation.
cards.short_summary: Twenty reservable Research Commons pods with tables and LCD displays for groups.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library reports that YRL has 20 first-floor Research Commons collaboration pods seating six to eight people, each with an LCD screen.
cards.source_title: Charles E. Young Research Library | UCLA Library
cards.access_notes: Reservable through UCLA Library; review the current reservation policy and location hours before planning a group session.

cards.title: Garden Commons
cards.subtitle: A-level, Charles E. Young Research Library
cards.notes: Use the A-level setup for laptop or map-based work, with power outlets, a printer, maps, and microform available in the same space.
cards.short_summary: An A-level YRL study area with power, printing, maps, and microform.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library states that the Garden Commons on YRL’s A-level includes study spaces with power outlets, a printer, maps, and microform.
cards.source_title: Charles E. Young Research Library | UCLA Library
cards.access_notes: Located on YRL’s A-level; consult the Charles E. Young Research Library page for current hours and access details.

cards.entity_name: Arts Library Quiet Study Reading Room
cards.title: Arts Library Quiet Study Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Fifth floor, Arts Library
cards.notes: Choose an individual carrel, table, or other seat in this room when you want quiet study within the Arts Library’s fifth-floor setting.
cards.short_summary: A fifth-floor quiet room with individual carrels, tables, and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library describes the Arts Library Quiet Study Reading Room as a fifth-floor space reserved for quiet study with individual carrels, tables, and varied seating.
cards.access_notes: The room is reserved for quiet study and is on the fifth floor; verify current Arts Library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Walter H. Rubsamen Music Library Reading Room
cards.title: Walter H. Rubsamen Music Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Walter H. Rubsamen Music Library, Schoenberg Music Building
cards.notes: Use the library’s main study space for quiet work, while checking the location calendar because the room also supports concerts, jam sessions, and recitals.
cards.short_summary: The Music Library’s main quiet-study space, which also hosts music events.
cards.evidence_claim: UCLA Library says the Walter H. Rubsamen Music Library Reading Room is its main study space, available for quiet study and also used for concerts, jam sessions, and recitals.
cards.source_title: Walter H. Rubsamen Music Library | UCLA Library
cards.access_notes: Located in the Schoenberg Music Building; check current Music Library hours and events before visiting.
